description:
Your little hero will love the vibrant PAW Patrol graphics featuring Chase, Rubble, and the gang! With a durable steel frame and bold design, this bike is ready for every exciting mission. Backed by our limited lifetime frame warranty.
Keep little riders safe with the fully enclosed chain guard, protecting fingers while adding vibrant Paw Patrol graphics. The removable training wheels provide stability as they build confidence to ride on their own.
Soft, paw-printed grips make every ride comfortable and fun for little hands. Designed for a secure hold, these handlebars help kids stay in control as they pedal through their next adventure.
The quick-adjust seat makes it easy to ensure the perfect fit as your little rider grows. Featuring bold Paw Patrol graphics, this seat adds both comfort and character to every ride.

components.description: Confidence with Every Stop: Rear coaster brake provides smooth and easy stopping, perfect for young riders gaining skills.
